families.name: Orientation and Tracing
families.phrase: Create the shared semantic field: purpose, premise, actor-impact traces, and role context.

families.name: Comparison and Threshold
families.phrase: Make sufficiency, priority, and future-state shape visible.

families.name: Shared Surfaces and Topology
families.phrase: Show what is shared, layered, connected, attached, or operationally supported.

families.name: Participatory Elicitation and Specification
families.phrase: Turn lived workflow and verbal agreement into manipulable artifacts and concrete examples.

families.name: Measurement, Reflection, and Judgment
families.phrase: Interpret evidence, preserve lived experience, and surface practitioner judgment.

families.name: Pattern Fit and Behavior Protection
families.phrase: Align pattern choices, job salience, and protected behavior with the work that matters.

families.name: Recovery Routing and Revision
families.phrase: Route strain, preserve continuity, and update prior artifacts with better evidence.
